title: Unity Spark Promises To Let You Vibe Code Your 'Dream Game' In The Most Embarrassing Video Imaginable
key_facts: Unity has announced Spark, an AI tool that lets people with no game-development experience make and share games in the browser.
Spark is listed as coming soon, with a waitlist button.
Unity's own post says asking AI to regurgitate an already-invented game does not make you a great game maker.
Unity's trailer shows a user typing six words to build a shooter called Space Corridor from artist-made assets.
Kotaku says the trailer's example game is generic and that a playable version is online, about five minutes long.
Kotaku's criticism is its own opinion of the trailer.
quote_evidence: Unity Spark is a “new way for people to come together to make and share games right in their browser,” explains Unity, boasting “no prior Unity or game development experience required.”
Unity Spark is listed as “coming soon,” with a waitlist button for excited future corridor designers to press.
YOU CAN PLAY SPACE CORRIDOR RIGHT NOW!
why_it_matters_hint: A major games-engine maker sells AI game creation to beginners; the sample trailer looks weak.
